Are drift cars able to perform in a straight-line drag race?!
It’s time for a BMW head-to-head… With a difference!
We’ve got Mat in the stock BMW M2, and he’s lining up against an E30 BMW 3 Series.
But this is no ordinary BMW 3 Series! It’s a Red Bull drift car with a huge engine under the bonnet, and on paper it looks like it could seriously push the BMW M2 all the way! So let’s take a closer look at the stats…
